background.value: light color (white, cream, light grey, or light blue); uniform, plain, no gradation, free of shadows and patterns

head_height.value: 31-36mm from top of forehead to bottom of chin; space must remain between crown and top edge of photo and on both sides of face; neck and upper shoulders must also be visible

validity.value: taken within 6 months before submitting application

expression_restriction.value: neutral facial expression, mouth shut, no smiling

glasses_policy.value: allowed but no reflecting or tinted glasses; frames should not be too big but not too close to the eyeline; glasses may be removed even if worn daily

face_visibility.value: face totally uncovered; forehead, chin and the part towards the ears must be visible; eyes perfectly visible

ears_visibility.value: the part towards the ears must be visible (face totally uncovered requirement)
